rules.match: ^data_E22\.tar\.gz:(?P<member>[A-Za-z0-9]+/gbar_gobs_[A-Za-z0-9]+\.fits):row (?P<row>\d+), (?P<column>GOBS); the source computed g: non-parametric hydrostatic reconstruction evaluated at the radii of the data \(E22 §3\.4, l\. 263\); g_obs = G M_HSE\(<r\)/r² \(l\. 453\)$
rules.note: Value from S1 (member, HDU 1, row, column). In S3, hydromass.tex: l. 263 is in §3.5 (Optimization), not §3.4; it says the reconstruction is evaluated at the radii of the observed data. The source does not state which of its two methods for g_obs (nonparametric reconstruction or Einasto fit, l. 458) the released column holds (reading/model_form.md); the text's 'non-parametric' is an association (l. 263, l. 445), not a statement. l. 453: g_obs = G M_HSE(<r)/r². Issue #234; D-119.
rules.correction: E22 §3.4, l. 263; and "non-parametric hydrostatic reconstruction" as the source of the released column

rules.match: ^data_E22\.tar\.gz:(?P<member>[A-Za-z0-9]+/gbar_gobs_[A-Za-z0-9]+\.fits):row (?P<row>\d+), (?P<column>GBAR); the source computed g, including the central galaxy's dynamical mass-to-light ratio: G \(M_gas \+ M★,BCG \+ M★,sat\)\(<r\)/r² \(E22 l\. 456\); ICL excluded \(l\. 410\)$
rules.note: Value from S1. In S3, hydromass.tex: the dynamical mass-to-light ratio of the central galaxy is in §2.4.1 (BCG), l. 101–112, not l. 456; l. 456 is the g_bar equation; l. 410: 'Intracluster light, which is not included in our analysis'. Issue #234; D-119.
rules.correction: E22 l. 456 for the central galaxy's dynamical mass-to-light ratio
